viewFor.returns: V (a copy of the state, projected and concealed; the state is not changed)

viewerOf.returns: Viewer (a display never has an id)

redact.returns: Record<string,unknown>[] (one per record, same order: open facts plus each hidden key as its value if the viewer owns the record or the key is revealed, else null; a revealed index list keeps those elements of an array and nulls the rest; a null viewer is a display and sees only what is revealed; server)

types.rule path: 'field' or 'a.b' for a field of the state; 'items[].field' for a field of every element of the array 'items'
types.HiddenRecord: {ownerId:string|null,open:Record<string,unknown>,hidden:Record<string,unknown>,revealed:Record<string,true|number[]>} (facts grouped by owner: open ones everyone sees, hidden ones only the owner sees until revealed)
